mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases the risk of recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 8.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor force employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a 3-month window, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by annual GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is above 2.0% annually and INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has increased for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% in a 3-month window, it signals an inflationary pressure that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen above 3.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a 3-month window, it indicates a stagflationary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained environment (as indicated by annual industrial production growth (INDPRO) below 1.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth is below 1.0% annually and INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
